sources.title: Time Series and Forecasting: Chicago Crime - Amazon Web Services
sources.snippet: With the Chicago crime dataset, our aim is to develop a prediction model using time series analysis to forecast crime frequency. Through this analysis, we will investigate if there are discernible patterns that indicate the likelihood of a crime occurring and identify specific time periods that demand increased vigilance and caution.
